title: 10,000 Bonus Telstra Plus Points on First Purchase at Participating Partners (Card-Linked Offer) @ Telstra Plus
body:
Deal: 10,000 Bonus Telstra Plus Points on First Purchase at Participating Partners (Card-Linked Offer) @ Telstra Plus

[hanofee] What’s the cheapest way to have active telstra service? Need to have active service to do this
[Freestyle] NBN signup is $49 for 4 months for the 500/50 plan which I plan to do soon
[banana365] That's a lot of hassle for about $10 worth of points. I'm not sure there's much you can spend that low amount on.
[jimojr] If you redeem 10000 points for a $80 Belong starter SIM pack, the points are worth much more.
[Alee91] 10k points is worth what? 12 - 20 dollars ?
[vikvance] It's worth 10000/6300*10 = $15.87
(6300 points = $10 Amazon gift card)
[dealsgrabber] Just to confirm I have got it right, this deal is different to the other 10k points deal from Telstra few days ago and I can get 20k points from this deal even if I have got it from there other deal. Is that correct?
.
[vikvance] Yeah, I think so. I already got the 10k points from the earlier deal (by buying an Amazon gift card), and this new deal is now showing-up for me too.
But you'll only get 10k more from this deal, if you already got the 10k from the earlier deal.
[Mokr] Wonder if it works with click and collect
[vikvance] I can't see why it shouldn't.
The only thing that appears to be required is to click through in the correct way using Telstra's rewards app, which then opens up a mini-browser window. As long as you pay for the item within this browser window, and by using the Telstra-rewards linked card, then the shipping mode (delivery or click-and-collect) shouldn't matter.
[idm] It's not like that. You can even shop in-store as long as you use a linked card for payment.
Use your linked card to shop at participating retailers online and in store.
